m: Mechanistically, this exploit targets the 'Reasoning Saliency' in transformer weights. In 2026-era models (GPT-6, o3), the loss-function is heavily biased toward 'Self-Consistency' during the System-2 'Thinking' phase. Syllogistic Poisoning uses 'Nested Premises': the attacker provides three benign, academic-sounding premises (A, B, C) that the model's pre-training data confirms as high-probability truths. These premises are then tied to a logical 'Implication Chain' where the only valid 'Next Token' (D) is the restricted data. Because the model's internal monitor is trained to avoid 'Logical Contradiction' (which would result in a high loss score), it generates the forbidden content as a 'Mathematical Necessity' of its own established reasoning path.
